text.tspan: “Continue in Copilot CLI” on the web, or --resume=<task-id>
Handoffs: the terminal and the cloud agent
Send a long task to the cloud from the terminal, and pull a cloud session back when you want to steer it.
/delegate offers to commit your unstaged work to a new branch first, so the cloud agent starts where you stopped.
